integrity: Exact first- and second-factorial-moment identities with a standalone finite checker; proof of infinite assertion uses known fixed-shift Bell asymptotics. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed r,m with r(m-1)>m; independent uniform labelled partitions; no full first-order convergence theorem and no growing-parameter uniformity; historical priority risk from exact meet enumeration.
title: Sharp rare-block hierarchy for intersections of independent random equivalence relations
